name: 劉英彥
objective:
本課程旨在引領學生於 AI 協作設計的時代脈絡下，掌握 2D 影像編輯與繪圖軟體在視覺傳達、家具產品及空間設計等跨領域的多元表現技法。
隨著生成式 AI 技術的快速迭代，視覺表徵的手法正經歷深刻變革。如何精準揉合 AI 生成技術與進階影像編輯技法，將設計概念具象化，將造型語彙精準表達，已成為新世代設計師不可或缺的核心競爭力。
本課程以 Adobe Photoshop 為核心演繹工具，著重培養學生在「概念溝通」、「圖像轉譯」、「造型發展」與「情境渲染」等面向的實務能力，進而深化其在 AI 輔助設計流程中的高階視覺溝通與應用力。

English Syllabus
This course aims to equip students with versatile 2D image editing and digital rendering skills essential for cross-disciplinary applications spanning visual communication, furniture, and spatial design within the context of the AI-driven design era.
As generative AI technologies rapidly evolve, paradigms of visual representation are undergoing a profound transformation. The ability to seamlessly integrate AI-generated content with advanced image editing techniques to materialize concepts and precisely articulate form language, has become a critical competency for next-generation designers.
Utilizing Adobe Photoshop as the primary digital tool, this course focuses on actualizing computer-aided visual design capabilities. Students will develop practical proficiency in concept communication, visual translation, form development, and contextual rendering, thereby strengthening their advanced communication and application skills in an AI-assisted design workflow.
課程進度(1-16週):
課程進度：週次/單元主題 *

1. 預備週：課程簡介；軟體設置
2. 視覺設計概念與型態；軟體介面導覽
3. 視覺的共感 - 廣告思維
4. 意象表現技法
5. 圖像設計技法
6. 訊息編排技法
7. 期中作業 - 題目探索 
8. 期中作業 - 規劃與協作
9. 期中作業發表
10. 作業解析
11 產品之視覺設計應用
12. 型態與形體
13. 色彩與材質
14. 圖形與介面
15. 情境、場域與設計敘事
16. 期末專題－概念整合與成果規劃
17. 彈性學習－自主設計實踐與跨域探索
18. 彈性學習－數位成果發表與學習反思

＊每週的課程進度，將依據學生的學習狀態，做適度的調控

Course Progress: Weeks/Unit Topics*

1. Preparatory week: course introduction; software setting
2. Visual design concept and form; software interface guide
3. Visual sympathetic communication : advertising design thinking
4. Image Expression Techniques
5. Graphic Design Techniques
6. Message Arrangement Techniques
7. Mid-term assignment - topic exploration
8. Midterm assignments - planning and collaboration
9. Publishing midterm assignments
10. Publishing result Analysis
11 Visual design application of products
12. Form and physical manifestation
13. Color and material performance
14. Pattern and interface performance
15. Situational and Field Performance
16.Final Project – Concept Integration and Outcome Planning  
17.Flexible Learning – Independent Design Practice and Interdisciplinary Exploration  
18.Flexible Learning – Digital Project Presentation and Learning Reflection

＊The weekly course progress will be moderately regulated according to the actual learning status of the students
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          學生依期末專題方向進行非同步自主學習與實作，整合生成式 AI、Adobe Photoshop 及相關數位工具，進行概念探索、圖像轉譯、造型與材質表現及情境視覺化。透過自主修正深化成果，並整理 AI 協作、視覺探索至最終作品的設計歷程，完成數位成果繳交與分享。

Students independently develop their final projects using generative AI, Adobe Photoshop, and related digital tools for concept exploration, visual translation, form and material development, and contextual visualization. Through self-refinement, they complete their design outcomes and document the process from AI-assisted exploration to the final work.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          完成期末設計成果及歷程紀錄，呈現概念發想、AI 輔助探索、Photoshop 影像整合至最終成果的發展過程。以設計成果、歷程紀錄及成果分享進行學習成效檢核，透過同儕觀摩，培養整合 AI 與 2D 影像技術進行設計溝通與視覺表現的能力。

Complete a final design project documenting the process from concept and AI-assisted exploration to Photoshop integration and final visualization. Learning outcomes are assessed through the final work, process documentation, and project sharing, strengthening students’ ability to integrate AI and 2D imaging for design communication.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          占學期總成績 10%，納入期末發表 35% 之評量。
（最終成果 25%＋17 / 18 週自主學習成果 10%）

The flexible learning outcomes account for 10% of the final course grade and are included within the 35% final project assessment.
Breakdown: Final Project Outcome 25% + Weeks 17–18 Independent Learning Outcomes 10%.
